title: Benefits of physical activity

draft.title: Benefits of physical activity
card: Regular activity strengthens the heart, lungs, muscles and bones. It also helps manage body weight and lowers the risk of conditions such as type 2 diabetes.
Activity can build friendships, teamwork and a sense of belonging, for example through a club or a walking group.
Mental benefits include better focus and memory. Emotional benefits include lower stress and a better mood, and a stronger sense of self-worth.
Activity can give a sense of meaning, purpose or connection to something larger, such as to nature, culture or community.
draft.remember: Activity can help the body, relationships, thinking, feelings and sense of meaning.

a.q: Sam joins a Saturday touch football team and enjoys feeling part of the group. Which benefit is this mainly?
a.why: Feeling part of a group and building friendships is a social benefit. Touch football also works the body, so physical benefits are present, but the gain Sam describes is belonging.
a.clue: Look at what Sam enjoys, not what the sport does to the body.

b.q: Priya walks alone along a bush track each week. She says it calms her and lets her feel connected to the land. Which benefits does she describe?
b.why: Feeling calm is an emotional benefit, and feeling connected to the land is a spiritual benefit. Walking can also bring physical gains, but Priya does not describe any. She walks alone, so social benefits do not fit.
b.clue: Match each thing she says to a type of benefit, and note she walks alone.
